_note: Draft English rendering of Saadia's JA Tafsir on Bamidbar 3, generated by scripts/translate_tafsir_english.py against the JA (not the biblical Hebrew). Translation goal: reverse-translatability for the Tafsir reader — readers should be able to map English back to JA. Saadia-specific moves preserved per data-source/saadia-gloss-table.json; Blau's notes (data-source/blau-genesis-notes.json) consulted for Bereshit 1-12.

translations.1: And this is the lineage of the people of Aaron and Moses, at the time God spoke to Moses on Mount Sinai.
translations.2: And these are the names of the sons of Aaron: the firstborn Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Itamar.
translations.3: These are the names of the sons of Aaron — the anointed imāms, whose obligation to the imāmate was fulfilled.
translations.4: And Nadab and Abihu died, because they offered a strange fire before God in the wilderness of Sinai, and they had no sons; and Eleazar and Itamar served in the presence of Aaron their father.
translations.5: Then God spoke to Moses in speech.
translations.6: Bring forward the tribe of Levi, and station them before Aaron the imām, that they may serve him.
translations.7: And they shall keep his charge and the charge of the congregation, before the tent of the assembly, and shall perform the service of the tabernacle.
translations.8: And they shall keep all the vessels of the tent of the assembly, and the charge of the sons of Israel, to perform the service of the tabernacle.
translations.9: And deliver the Levites to Aaron and his sons — given, entrusted they are to him, from the sons of Israel.
translations.10: And Aaron and his sons you shall appoint, and they shall keep their imāmate; and any outsider who approaches it shall be put to death.
translations.11: Then God spoke to Moses in speech.
translations.12: For I have distinguished the Levites from among the sons of Israel, in place of every firstborn, the first of the womb from the sons of Israel — so the Levites shall be Mine.
translations.13: As all the firstborn are Mine — on the day I destroyed every firstborn in the land of Egypt, I consecrated to Myself every firstborn among the sons of Israel, from human to beast; thus shall these be Mine. I am God who distinguished them.
translations.14: Then God spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, saying:
translations.15: Count the sons of Levi by the houses of their fathers, by their clans — every male from a month old and upward you shall count them.
translations.16: And Moses counted them at the word of God, as he was commanded.
translations.17: And these were the sons of Levi by their names: Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari.
translations.18: And these are the names of the sons of Gershon by their clans: Libni and Shimei.
translations.19: And the sons of Kohath by their clans: Amram and Izhar, Hebron and Uzziel.
translations.20: And the sons of Merari by their clans: Mahli and Mushi. These are the clans of the Levites by the houses of their fathers.
translations.21: To Gershon: the clan of Libni and the clan of Shimei — these are their clans.
translations.22: And their count, by the census of every male from a month old and upward, was seven thousand five hundred.
translations.23: And their clans shall encamp behind the tabernacle in the west.
translations.24: And their noble is Eliasaph son of Lael.
translations.25: And their charge from the tent of the assembly: the tabernacle and the tent and its covering, and the curtain of the entrance of the tent of the assembly.
translations.26: And the hangings of the court and the curtain of its entrance, which is around the tabernacle and the altar, and their cords, and all the rest of their service.
translations.27: And to Kohath: the clan of Amram and the clan of Izhar, and the clan of Hebron, and the clan of Uzziel — these are his clans.
translations.28: By the census of every male from a month old and upward: eight thousand six hundred, keepers of the charge of the sanctuary.
translations.29: And their clans shall encamp beside the tabernacle to the south.
translations.30: And their noble is Elizaphan son of Uzziel.
translations.31: And their charge: the ark, and the table, and the lampstand, and the altars, and the vessels of the sanctuary with which they serve, and the veil, and all the rest of its service.
translations.32: And the noble of the nobles of the Levites is Eleazar son of Aaron the imām, appointed over the keepers of the charge of the sanctuary.
translations.33: And to Merari: the clan of Mahli and the clan of Mushi — these are his clans.
translations.34: And their count, by the census of every male from a month old and upward: six thousand two hundred.
translations.35: And their noble is Zuriel son of Abihail; and they shall encamp beside the tabernacle to the north.
translations.36: And the trusteeship of the charge of the sons of Merari: the planks of the tabernacle, and its bars, and its pillars, and its bases, and all its vessels, and all the rest of its service.
translations.37: And the pillars of the court all around, and their bases and their pegs and their cords.
translations.38: And those encamped before the tabernacle, before the tent of the assembly to the east — Moses and Aaron and his sons, keepers of the charge of the sanctuary and the charge of the sons of Israel; and any outsider who approaches that shall be put to death.
translations.39: And that is the entire count of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron counted at the word of God, by their clans — every male from a month old and upward: twenty-two thousand.
translations.40: Then God said to Moses: 'Count every firstborn male of the sons of Israel, from a month old and upward, and raise a census of their names.'
translations.41: 'And take the Levites for Me — I am God who distinguished them — in place of every firstborn from the sons of Israel; and the beasts of the Levites in place of every firstborn from the beasts of the sons of Israel.'
translations.42: And Moses counted, as God had commanded him, every firstborn from the sons of Israel.
translations.43: And all the firstborn males, by the census of their names, from a month old and upward, came to: twenty-two thousand two hundred and seventy-three.
translations.44: Then God spoke to Moses in speech.
translations.45: 'Take the Levites in place of every firstborn from the sons of Israel, and the beasts of the Levites in place of their beasts — and the Levites shall be Mine; I am God who distinguished them.'
translations.46: 'And as for the redemption of the two hundred and seventy-three who exceed the Levites from the firstborn of the sons of Israel —'
translations.47: 'take five shekels for each head — in silver, by the shekels of the sanctuary, each shekel being twenty dāniq.'
translations.48: 'And deliver the silver to Aaron and his sons — the redemption of those who exceed them.'
translations.49: And Moses took the silver of the redemption from those who exceeded the Levites.
translations.50: From the firstborn of the sons of Israel he took that silver: one thousand three hundred and sixty-five shekels, by the shekel of the sanctuary.
translations.51: And Moses delivered the silver of the redemption to Aaron and his sons, at the word of God, as he was commanded.
